messages:
eli: Hey team, joining remote from Spain next week. Two quick security/onboarding things before Day 1:
1) I prefer using an Android phone for MFA (authenticator app + NFC YubiKey via OTG). Is that supported?
2) I keep research datasets on a small Synology NAS at home for experiments. Can I rsync backups there from a loaner machine, or is that blocked?
3) Also need a temporary split-tunnel VPN rule for a research partner host (EU-only). Who approves that?

marco: Welcome @eli :wave: Short answers: Android MFA supported (Authenticator + WebAuthn via OTG with supported keys). We do BYOD MDM for phones that access corp apps. Regarding backups, we disallow automatic syncs to personal devices for any machine with access to internal datasets. Manual ad-hoc transfers without secrets might be allowed after review.

security: Hi Eli A few details: Android MFA - we support Google Authenticator / Authy + hardware keys via OTG for Android 8+. If you use OTG YubiKey, we need you to register it in the company 2FA portal and note it as a personal key. For BYOD we require the minimal MDM "BYOD" profile if you access email or internal apps.

security: For Synology backups: automatic rsync from a company-issued device is not permitted for any dataset that contains internal or third-party data. If your work is purely public/synthetic, you can request an exception and we will require:
- DAR (data access request) marking "personal backup"
- encryption in transit + at rest on the NAS (must use strong cipher)
- no persistent service account credentials on the host (use short-lived tokens)
We prefer using our approved secure transfer routes (s3 presigned or secure transfer appliance) for anything non-public.

it-support: @eli For the split-tunnel VPN exception: open an IT ticket with subject "vpn-exception-eu-research" and include the partner host IP(s), justification, dates, and manager approval. Security triages and if approved we'll provision a scoped exception with expiry. Note: we avoid permanent split-tunnel rules; approvals are time-boxed (default 7 days).

eli: Thanks all. If I register a personal YubiKey on the 2FA portal, does that mean IT can remote-wipe it or revoke it centrally?

security: Registering a personal hardware key only ties it to your account. We can revoke keys centrally (e.g., if lost or compromised) but we will not physically wipe a personal key. For company keys we can deprovision and request return.

phishsim-bot: Scheduled phish simulation enrollment: eli added to "europe-newhires" cohort. First simulated phish will be delivered ~3 business days after first_message_ts. Failure triggers the 20-min micro-training and a manager notification for repeat fails.

eli: Great. One last Q: any country-specific compliance notes for Spain I should be aware of for data handling?

security: GDPR applies as usual. If you process EU personal data we require data minimization, processing agreements, and a local data owner approval on the DAR. We'll flag that in your DAR review. Also note export controls for certain models/datasets - if you're working with model weights that are restricted, ping legal early.

eli: Perfect 97 I'll open the DAR and the VPN ticket today. Thanks for the quick responses :thumbsup:
